Third-party code bundled with the My Library phone app

zxing-library-0.23.0.min.js
  ZXing ("zebra crossing") TypeScript port, @zxing/library 0.23.0 (UMD build, unmodified except the
  sourceMappingURL comment was removed). https://github.com/zxing-js/library
  License: Apache License 2.0 - see ZXING-LICENSE.txt.
  Only loaded when the browser has no native BarcodeDetector (Chrome on Android has one).
